lines.en: I drag my steps, walking slowly.
My flesh is colder than my shadow.
I creep along the wall, shunning the light.
A wet trail follows behind me.
One step, then I stop and listen.

lines.zh: 我的肢体有点不听使唤
lines.en: My limbs don't quite obey me.

lines.zh: 我从阴影走到另一片阴影
lines.en: I cross from one shadow to the next.

lines.zh: 草地上留下灰色的印子
lines.en: Grey marks are left on the grass.
I move toward that house.
Every breath carries the sound of water.
I follow the fence, very quietly.

lines.zh: 走过的地方，虫都不叫了
lines.en: Where I pass, the insects fall silent.

lines.zh: 我的手指在空中慢慢张开
lines.en: My fingers open slowly in the air.

lines.zh: 我一步步朝有人的岸上走。
lines.en: Step by step I head for the peopled shore.

lines.zh: 我绕开积水，不想弄出声
lines.en: I skirt the puddles to stay silent.

lines.zh: 我停下来，回头看了一眼
lines.en: I stop and glance back.
I stand like a piece of wet wood.
Water still drips from me.
I remember who I once was.
The thought scatters quickly.

lines.zh: 我抬手看了看，不像人的手
lines.en: I look at my hand; it isn't human.
I tilt my head at a distant call.

lines.zh: 这身体在慢慢变，我拦不住
lines.en: This body is changing; I can't stop it.
I crouch and hold my knees.
Wind passes. I don't feel cold.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出低低的水声。
lines.en: A low watery sound rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 我盯着一片叶子看了很久
lines.en: I stare at a leaf for a long time.
I seem to have forgotten which way to go.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，天上没有月亮
lines.en: I look up. There's no moon.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会来的声音
lines.en: I wait for a sound that won't come.
You still smell human.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子响了一下
lines.en: I raise my head; my neck clicks.
I don't remember your face.

lines.zh: 你退后了，我往前走一步
lines.en: You back away; I take one step.
Don't shout. It won't help.

lines.zh: 我想起有人这样看过我
lines.en: I recall someone looking at me like that.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，我都看见了。
lines.en: Your hands shake — I see it all.
I reach out, then pull my hand back.
I wasn't supposed to be like this.
Where are you going? Take me along.
I recoil, stiffly.
That blow folds me over.
It doesn't hurt much. I'm just afraid.
I press the wound; my blood is thin.
A hiss escapes my throat.
Unsteady, I lean on the wall.
My body moves as if to flee.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看自己的手
lines.en: I look down at my own hands.
That blow broke something in me.
Stop. I still remember myself.
That smell is unfamiliar.
I turn my head slowly to look.
Food means nothing to me now.
I reach out, then stop.

lines.zh: 你举着它，像在喂一只狗
lines.en: You hold it out as if feeding a dog.
I sniff, then pull back.
This reminds me of before.
I shake my head, stiffly.
I don't want it. Put it away.
I don't remember how to eat.
I bump into you and pause.

lines.zh: 你身上是暖的，我记住了。
lines.en: You're warm — I've noted that.
I step back and clear the way.

lines.zh: 肩膀一碰，你就偏了半步。
lines.en: One touch of shoulders and you shift half a step.
Sorry. I can't walk straight.
I press to the wall so you can pass.

lines.zh: 撞这一下，我没什么感觉
lines.en: That bump barely registers.
Don't push. I can't keep my feet.
My hand is much colder than yours.

lines.zh: 我们靠得很近，我退开了
lines.en: We were close; I pulled away.
I've forgotten how to be close.
Would you stay?

lines.zh: 我身上很冷，你会受不了
lines.en: I'm cold. You couldn't bear it.

lines.zh: 以前的我也许会牵你的手
lines.en: The old me might have taken your hand.

lines.zh: 我们坐一会儿，不说什么
lines.en: Let's sit a while and say nothing.
I fear I'd hurt you.
Leave before dawn.
I don't want you to become like me.
I remember someone waiting for me.
Even the abandoned long for the shore.
I crouch and pick it up.
My fingers won't quite obey.
I hold it and look at it a while.
I'd have had a use for this before.

lines.zh: 我把它放回原来的水洼。
lines.en: I set it back in the puddle it came from.
It takes two tries to grasp it.
My fingers lock when I grip.
I hold it out to you.
This is meaningless to me.
I grip it hard and don't let go.
Something moved by the water.
That's a pillager.
I remember that kind.

lines.zh: 我的身体先于念头动了
lines.en: My body moves before my thought.
A witch's smell — sharp.
I turn my head toward it.
My fingers start to twitch.
I recognize that uniform.
It hasn't seen me. Good.
I don't want to fight, but my body does.
I follow it, slowly, close to cover.
My steps make no sound.
It stops; so do I.
Only a few paces between us.
It looks back; I don't move.
I don't breathe, and don't need to.
It's heading toward the village.
I must stop it before it reaches the village.
I cut around to the path it will take.
It's inside my shadow now.
I reach out and seize it.
My fingers sink in.
It struggles twice, then goes still.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己为什么打
lines.en: I don't know why I'm striking.
I press it against the wall.
I'm stronger than I thought.
That wasn't what I wanted.
I let go, and it slides down.
I look at my hand. It's strange.
I back away. I don't want to look.
I open my eyes in the dark.
Cold water covers me.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己躺了多久
lines.en: I don't know how long I lay here.
My body has changed a great deal.
I try to stand. It's hard work.
Lights are on in the village beyond.

lines.zh: 我想起自己叫什么，又忘了
lines.en: I recall my name, then lose it.

lines.zh: 草叶碰我的腿，我没有感觉
lines.en: Grass touches my legs; I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 我听到自己的呼吸很湿
lines.en: My own breathing sounds wet.
There's wind, but no cold.
Fire reminds me I still fear pain.

lines.zh: 摔下来时我听见骨头的响
lines.en: Falling, I hear my bones crack.

lines.zh: 水包住我，我竟觉得亲切
lines.en: Water closes over me, and it feels like home.
The blast throws me far.
An arrow stands in my shoulder.
This light burns my skin.
I stopped being hungry long ago, yet I weaken.
Lightning strikes me, and I convulse.

lines.zh: 我看见黑色把我吞进去
lines.en: I watch the blackness swallow me.
